events.title: Launch
events.detail: Saturn V lifts off from Kennedy Space Center with Armstrong, Aldrin and Collins.

events.title: Earth orbit
events.detail: Parking orbit at about 190 km while systems are checked.

events.title: Trans-lunar injection
events.detail: The third stage fires for 6 minutes, sending them toward the Moon.

events.title: Lunar orbit insertion
events.detail: Behind the Moon, out of contact, the engine slows them into orbit.

events.title: Eagle undocks
events.detail: Armstrong and Aldrin separate in the lunar module.

events.title: Powered descent
events.detail: Eagle's engine fires for the final 12½ minutes to the surface.

events.title: “The Eagle has landed”
events.detail: Touchdown in the Sea of Tranquility with seconds of fuel margin.

events.title: First step
events.detail: “That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.”

events.title: Lunar liftoff
events.detail: Eagle's ascent stage leaves the descent stage behind.

events.title: Docking
events.detail: Eagle rejoins Columbia in lunar orbit.

events.title: Trans-Earth injection
events.detail: Behind the Moon again, the engine fires to head home.

events.title: Splashdown
events.detail: Columbia lands in the Pacific, 8 days, 3 hours after launch.
